TimeEntryAdjustmentRequest.description: Request to create a time entry adjustment

notes.example: Employee forgot to log lunch break

minutesDelta.description: Adjustment in minutes (positive to add time, negative to subtract)

TimeEntryAdjustmentResponse.description: Response from creating or updating a time entry adjustment

adjustmentId.description: Unique identifier of the created or updated adjustment

success.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful

TimeEntryExceptionRequest.description: Request to create a time entry exception

employeeId.description: Employee identifier associated with the exception

exceptionCode.description: Exception code identifying the type of exception

timeEntryId.description: Time entry identifier associated with the exception

resolutionNotes.description: Notes describing the exception or initial resolution steps
resolutionNotes.example: Employee forgot to clock out at end of shift

detectedAt.description: Timestamp when the exception was detected

TimeEntryExceptionResponse.description: Response from creating or updating a time entry exception

exceptionId.description: Unique identifier of the created or updated exception

success.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful

TimeEntryAdjustment.description: Time entry adjustment representing a proposed or approved change to a time entry

notes.example: Employee forgot to log lunch break

minutesDelta.description: Adjustment in minutes (positive to add time, negative to subtract)

createdBy.description: User who created the adjustment request

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the adjustment was created

decidedBy.description: User who approved or rejected the adjustment

decidedAt.description: Timestamp when the adjustment was approved or rejected

AttendanceDiscrepancyReportResponse.description: Attendance vs job time discrepancy row

totalAttendanceHours.description: Total attendance time in decimal hours

totalJobHours.description: Total approved job time in decimal hours

discrepancyHours.description: Attendance minus job time in decimal hours

isFlagged.description: True when absolute discrepancy exceeds threshold

thresholdApplied.description: Threshold in minutes used for this row

TimeEntryException.description: Time entry exception representing a discrepancy or issue with time tracking

employeeId.description: Employee identifier associated with the exception

workDate.description: Work date when the exception occurred

exceptionCode.description: Exception code identifying the type of exception

resolutionNotes.description: Notes describing resolution or actions taken

detectedAt.description: Timestamp when the exception was detected

resolvedAt.description: Timestamp when the exception was resolved
